ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

2. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 0 °C

3. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Iron rusting

4. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Only carbon dioxide

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Forming shadows in light? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Forming shadows in light.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Forming shadows in light.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Forming shadows in light.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Forming shadows in light.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Energy: Light its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Energy: Light its resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy: Light its resources.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Energy: Light its resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Energy: Light its resources.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Soil and its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Soil and its resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Soil and its resources.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil and its resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Soil and its resources.

8. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather its resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather its resources.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather its resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Weather its resources.

10. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Overgrazing continuously

11. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Heating until a solid melts

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Transporting? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Transporting.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Transporting.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Transporting.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Transporting.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Safety when handling and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Energy: Light its resources and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Forming shadows in light and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Precautions when using and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
